cards.name: Rifle Squad
cards.flavor: Men in tin bowls who carry thunder-sticks. They sing about girls they left behind.

cards.name: Tommy Section
cards.flavor: They wear soup plates for hats and stop the war for tea. Nobody laughs twice.

cards.name: Airborne Paratroopers
cards.flavor: They step out of the sky beneath silk mushrooms, as if heaven had a back door.

cards.name: Rangers
cards.flavor: Climbed a sea-cliff under fire with ropes and ladders. Asked what was next.

cards.name: Commandos
cards.flavor: Green berets, blackened faces and very quiet boots.

cards.name: Combat Medic
cards.flavor: Carries no sword at all, only bandages and a terrible bravery.

cards.name: Forward Observer
cards.flavor: Squints through a brass far-glass and whispers to a box that answers.

cards.name: Sherman M4
cards.flavor: Tall as a hay-wain and twice as common. There is always another one.

cards.name: Churchill
cards.flavor: Slow as a sermon and armoured like a cathedral door.

cards.name: M7 Priest
cards.flavor: Named for its pulpit. Its sermons land three miles away.

cards.name: Willys Jeep
cards.flavor: A horseless cart that goes anywhere and brings back everything.

cards.name: Spitfire Mk IX
cards.flavor: Wings shaped like a beech leaf; it sings as it turns.

cards.name: P-51 Mustang
cards.flavor: A silver hawk that flies the bombers all the way there and all the way home.

cards.name: C-47 Dakota
cards.flavor: A flying barn. The paratroopers come out of the side door.

cards.name: Avro Lancaster
cards.flavor: Four engines roaring like a forge on a windy night.

cards.name: Grenadiers
cards.flavor: Coal-scuttle helmets and greatcoats to the shin.

cards.name: Fallschirmjäger
cards.flavor: Dropped from the clouds, then dug into a mountain monastery and would not leave.

cards.name: MG 42 Team
cards.flavor: Sounds like a loom tearing linen. Men call it the bone-saw.

cards.name: Field Surgeon
cards.flavor: Stitches faster than a sail-maker.

cards.name: Panzerfaust Troop
cards.flavor: A fist on a stick that punches through a castle gate. Once.

cards.name: Panzer IV
cards.flavor: The workhorse. Skirts of iron plate hang along its flanks like barding.

cards.name: Panther
cards.flavor: Sloped like a roof in snow country; its long gun reaches the next parish.

cards.name: Tiger I
cards.flavor: A steel beetle that breathes thunder. Villagers say it eats bridges.

cards.name: StuG III
cards.flavor: A low iron toad with a gun for a tongue, waiting in the hedgerow.

cards.name: 88 mm Flak
cards.flavor: Built to swat sky-dragons; equally happy to swat iron ones.

cards.name: Sd.Kfz. 251 Half-track
cards.flavor: Wheels at the front, a mill-belt at the back, and a squad in its belly.

cards.name: Messerschmitt Bf 109
cards.flavor: A narrow grey falcon with square-clipped wings.

cards.name: Ju 87 Stuka
cards.flavor: Folds its bent wings and falls screaming like a stooping hawk.

cards.name: Ju 52 Transport
cards.flavor: Corrugated like a washboard, three-engined, patient as a mule.

cards.name: Rifle Company
cards.flavor: There are always more of them coming over the snow.

cards.name: Guards Rifles
cards.flavor: Earned the word Guards in the ruins of a city on the Volga.

cards.name: Sniper Pair
cards.flavor: Two patient shadows and a rifle with a glass eye.

cards.name: Field Nurse
cards.flavor: Drags men twice her weight out of the fire, singing.

cards.name: Razvedchiki Scouts
cards.flavor: White smocks in white snow. You will not see them.

cards.name: T-34/85
cards.flavor: Wide tracks for the mud, sloped plate for the shells. The tractor-works make one an hour.

cards.name: KV-1
cards.flavor: A moving keep. Shot glances off it like hail off a church bell.

cards.name: Katyusha
cards.flavor: A wagon of organ pipes that sings fire. The other side calls it Stalin's organ.

cards.name: Studebaker Truck
cards.flavor: Came across the sea with flour, boots and a thousand cans of meat.

cards.name: Il-2 Sturmovik
cards.flavor: A flying tank. Its bathtub of armour shrugs off arrows and worse.

cards.name: Yak-3
cards.flavor: Light as a swift and as quick to turn.

cards.name: Tiger II
cards.flavor: Found crated in a barrow-mound: a beetle the size of a chapel.

cards.name: Me 262
cards.flavor: A falcon with no propeller at all. It screams past before the thunder arrives.

cards.name: de Havilland Mosquito
cards.flavor: Made of wood, like a good cart, and faster than anything with feathers.

cards.name: IS-2
cards.flavor: Its gun fires a shell the weight of a ten-year-old child.

cards.name: Mud Season
cards.flavor: Spring thaw turns every road into porridge. Iron wagons sink to the axles.

cards.name: Channel Fog
cards.flavor: Grey wool over the sea. No bird of iron flies today.

cards.name: Hard Frost
cards.flavor: So cold the grease freezes in the rifles and the men freeze to the grease.

cards.name: Smoke Screen
cards.flavor: Canisters that hiss white clouds: whatever blinded the field is gone.

cards.name: Air Superiority
cards.flavor: Own the sky and the rest follows. Clears fog; your Air units gain +2 this round.

cards.name: Pincer Movement
cards.flavor: Two arrows on the map close like a smith's tongs.

cards.name: Bletchley Park Codebreakers
cards.flavor: Clever folk in a country house, reading the enemy's letters before he does.

cards.name: Operation Fortitude
cards.flavor: An army of painted canvas and rubber tanks, inflated by four men and a bicycle pump.

cards.name: Blitzkrieg Doctrine
cards.flavor: Speed, surprise, iron. Your Armour gains +2 this round (+3 in Blitzkrieg).

cards.name: Rolling Barrage
cards.flavor: A wall of shells that walks across the field a few yards ahead of the infantry.

cards.name: Enigma Machine
cards.flavor: A typewriter with brass wheels that scrambles every letter. This one was dug out of a ruin.

commanders.name: The Supreme Commander
commanders.text: Clear all weather and draw a card.

commanders.name: The Air Marshal
commanders.text: Your Air units gain +2 this round.

commanders.name: The Field Marshal
commanders.text: Your Armour units gain +2 this round.

commanders.name: The Chief of Intelligence
commanders.text: Reveal the opponent's hand for the round and draw a card.

commanders.name: The Front Commander
commanders.text: Call up to two Infantry units from your deck onto the field.

commanders.name: General Winter
commanders.text: Hard Frost on the Infantry row; your own Infantry is entrenched against it.

allies.name: Western Allies
allies.text: Many tanks, many planes, much tea.

soviet.name: Soviets
soviet.text: Endless companies and very hard frost.

opponents.name: Jory Thatch
opponents.title: Farmer, plays on market days
opponents.style: Cautious. Plays his strongest cards early and rarely bluffs.
opponents.greet: "I don't hold with iron wagons, mind. But the frost card, now — that's honest weather."

opponents.name: Barnaby Quill
opponents.title: Host of the basement war-room
opponents.style: Knows every card. Holds tactics back for the right moment and enjoys a bluff.
opponents.greet: "Ah! A challenger! Mind the Tiger, she's freshly painted. Helmet on — regulations."

opponents.name: Pip Underbough
opponents.title: Bard, card-sharp, liar
opponents.style: Bluffs constantly, passes early, loves tricks and codebreakers.
opponents.greet: "Shall we make it interesting? No? Pity. I'll be Montgomery, you be confused."

opponents.name: Sigrun Halvard
opponents.title: Shield-maiden who plays for keeps
opponents.style: Aggressive and exact. Counts every point and never wastes a card.
opponents.greet: "Barnaby says you beat him. Show me."

abilities.spotter: Spotter — reveals two cards in the opponent's hand.
abilities.artillery: Artillery N — hits the strongest enemy unit in the named row for N.
abilities.barrage: Barrage N — hits every enemy unit in the named row for N.
abilities.entrench: Entrench — ignores weather and the next hit from artillery, assault or a pincer.
abilities.combined: Combined Arms N — +N while you hold a unit in another row.
abilities.reinforce: Reinforce — calls the rest of its company (or its passengers) out of your deck.
abilities.medic: Medic — returns your strongest fallen unit to your hand.
abilities.assault: Assault N — strikes the weakest enemy unit in the same row for N.
abilities.rally: Rally N — every other unit in its row gains +N.
abilities.elite: Elite — immune to weather, tactics and damage; never boosted.

tactics.weather: Weather — every non-elite unit in that row, on both sides, counts as 1.
tactics.air_superiority: Clears fog; your Air units gain +2 this round.
tactics.pincer: Destroys the strongest enemy unit (all ties) if it has 8 or more strength.
tactics.codebreakers: Reveals the opponent's whole hand for the round and steals one random card from it.
tactics.decoy: Play onto one of your units: it returns to your hand and the decoy takes its place at 0.
tactics.doctrine: Your Armour gains +2 this round (+3 in Blitzkrieg).
tactics.barrage: Hits every enemy unit in their most crowded row for 2.
